messages:
Nina Alvarez: Need to finalise pen-test readroom protocol. Key questions: RBAC TTL, KMS access, evidence retention. Proposing 3x2h slots in a 24h window. Thoughts?
Rahul Sen: 24h window ok. RBAC: short-lived role via OIDC, TTL 3h, single renewal only. Will template policy in the ticket.
Claire Ito: KMS: only allow wrapped data keys via kms-proxy. No plaintext keys. Ops must run proxy from bastion with session logging.
ops-bot: Note: evidence bucket must have object lock + versioning. Presigned uploads TTL = 6h. Manifest SHA256 required.
Nina Alvarez: Can ops add a healthcheck that verifies CloudTrail export to audit-bucket before readroom opens? We had a failed export last cycle.
ops-bot: Yes, will add lambda that checks latest export manifest and fails gate if missing.
Rahul Sen: Action items: Rahul = RBAC PR; Claire = kms-proxy runbook; Ops = presigned bucket + checksum lambda + healthcheck; Nina = publish retest slots and intake contact.
Nina Alvarez: Timeline: PRs/runbooks by EOD Tue. Ping me on Slack if blocked. :thumbsup:
